meta.title: Sun keep-out constrained retargeting slew
meta.note: Continuous-time explicit reference governor on SO(3) [Nakano et al., Automatica 2023]. Idealized: rigid body, no environmental torques, no wheel-momentum management, no body-rate limit, body-fixed solar arrays, single keep-out cone. Thresholds per Lemma 5, Lemma 8 and Eq. (16) of that paper.
